    DRIVER'S HANDBOOK

    KEEP THE QUEUE HAPPY

    1
    READ THE WHOLE BUBBLE

    Harder pitches include customers ordering two or three items. Finish every item before they leave.

    2
    SCROLL THE FULL MENU

    Swipe or scroll sideways through every available item. Number keys select the first nine products.

    3
    WATCH YOUR STOCK

    Cans are quick, but the fridge runs out. Restocking occupies a preparation slot.

    4
    UPGRADE & TRAVEL

    Improve each machine, handle group orders and unlock the complete world-tour menu.

    5
    WRONG ITEM? YOU PAY

    Selecting something nobody ordered deducts that item’s full price from today’s takings.

    6
    QUICK-SERVE SHORTCUTS

    Press Space for the first waiting order. Use Q and E to scroll along the full menu.
